title: An Empirical Study and Assessment of EU AI Act Compliance Checkers
abstract: arXiv:2609.36228v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The EU AI Act introduces extensive compliance requirements for organizations that develop, deploy, or integrate AI systems. Many of these requirements are directly relevant to security and privacy, while also addressing closely related issues such as data governance, transparency, accuracy, and robustness. However, stakeholders such as small-to-medium businesses and individual developers often lack the legal expertise required to interpret these obligations and translate them into engineering and governance practices. This disconnect creates challenges for implementing the EU AI Act and may lead to missing safeguards or misdirected development and deployment efforts. To address this, various automated EU AI Act compliance checkers (AIACCs) have emerged, claiming to streamline compliance assessments and provide practical guidance. translated_title: 欧盟《人工智能法案》合规检查工具的实证研究与评估
translated_abstract: 欧盟《人工智能法案》（EU AI Act）对开发、部署或集成人工智能系统的组织提出了广泛的合规要求。其中许多要求与安全和隐私直接相关，同时也涉及数据治理、透明度、准确性和鲁棒性等密切相关的问题。然而，中小企业和个人开发者等利益相关者往往缺乏将法律义务解释并转化为工程与治理实践所需的法律专业知识。这种脱节给欧盟《人工智能法案》的落地实施带来了挑战，可能导致安全保障措施的缺失或开发部署方向的偏差。为解决这一问题，各种自动化的欧盟《人工智能法案》合规检查工具（AIACCs）应运而生，它们声称能够简化合规评估并提供实用指导。在本文中，我们首次对AIACCs进行了实证研究与评估，我们对12个主流的AI合规检查工具进行了特征分析（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文首次对欧盟《人工智能法案》合规检查工具（AIACCs）开展了实证研究与评估，通过对12个主流工具的分析，帮助缺乏法律专业知识的中小企业和个人开发者更有效地实现合规。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first empirical study and assessment of EU AI Act compliance checkers (AIACCs), characterizing 12 mainstream tools to help stakeholders lacking legal expertise achieve compliance more effectively.
